title: We just launched a tool that lets anyone create their own educational video game in under 60 seconds — powered by AI!
author: Traditional_Chip_576
selftext:
Hey everyone,
We’re a small indie team working on BrainFusionLearning.games, a platform that allows anyone — students, teachers, or just curious minds — to create a fully playable educational game in less than a minute, just by typing in a theme.

The idea: You choose your topic (like biology, math, history…), and our AI builds a custom learning game for you in real-time. No coding needed. No downloads. Just type and play.

We’re still in early access and would love your feedback, ideas, or bug reports.
Would you find a tool like this useful? What would you add or change?

Try it here: https://brainfusionlearning.games

Thanks in advance for your time!
